# Nexa Website Security Policy

## Scope

Security review for this repository includes static HTML, CSS, JavaScript, local browser storage behavior, and repository publication configuration. This website does not advertise a live Nexa application or API endpoint.

## Reporting

Do not publish vulnerability details in a public issue. Use the repository host's private vulnerability reporting feature if it is enabled. No separate security contact address is published here.

Include the affected file or page, reproduction steps, expected and observed behavior, and browser details.

## Requirements

- Do not commit secrets, private contact data, or local artifacts.
- Keep external links accurate and HTTPS-based.
- Review third-party scripts and embeds before adding them.
- Keep privacy language aligned with current website behavior.
- Validate JavaScript syntax before publication.
